Stop actually stops, packages can be dragged into order, and the About card carries the versions.

## ✨ Added

- **Drag to reorder, links and packages both.** Long press to pick a row up: everything wiggles, the row lifts, and its neighbours move out of the way as it passes rather than on release, so the gap is always where the row would land. A package may only move among packages and a link only within its own package, because an order the list cannot render is one the instance cannot store either. The new order is written with the same call the web interface's own drag-and-drop makes.
- **"Über diese App"** carries the versions, one sentence inviting a report, and two buttons: the repository, and a mail with the subject already filled in. The quiet line under the last card is gone with it. Now GlimStone 1.7.0 for the whole family.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **Stop stops.** The button posted `halted: true`, which stops the *dispatcher*: nothing new starts and whatever is already downloading runs to the end. That is deliberate on the server ("killing a transfer mid-file throws away work the user did not ask to lose") and it is the wrong verb for a button labelled stop, because the bar somebody is watching keeps moving. It calls the hard stop now, the same one the web interface has always used.
- **A back badge left of the name, where Settings already puts one**, instead of an "Übersicht" button on the right. That was a destination where the gesture is a direction, and this app already draws "back" one way.
- **No gear inside an instance.** Settings are not a property of one instance, and offering them from inside one suggested they were. One door, on the screen that owns them.
- **The overview's summary card is exactly as wide as the cards it summarises**, and the Downloads/Collector strip is exactly as wide as the rows under it. Both were siblings of their list carrying their own copy of its width, cap and margins; both are part of the list now, where there is nothing left to keep in step.
